description:
## Question

Implement the per-shell buck2 option as settled, put the pinned buck2 on PATH of the selected shells, expose read-only `turnkey.buck2.version` (welcome message included), and make `buck2`/`buck2-toolchain` in any declaration file a hard evaluation error naming the migration note. Migrate turnkey's own toolchain.toml/flake.nix and the default template.

comments.text: Implement the interface settled in turnkey-luk.4 (see its resolution comment): buck2.shells list + master buck2.enable, read-only buck2.version in both modules, standalone devenv module resolves the pin itself.

Resolution: commit 385c53d0 (not pushed). buck2.shells (default ["default"]) under buck2.enable; read-only buck2.version in both modules; the pinned buck2 (same store path as buck2-toolchain 5) is on PATH of listed shells; welcome message shows 'buck2 2026-09-15'; declaring buck2/buck2-toolchain throws with a link to docs/user-manual/src/configuration/buck2-integration.md#the-buck2-version (turnkey-luk.7 must write that section with that heading); unknown names in buck2.shells throw. Deviation from turnkey-luk.4 Q5: the devenv module gets the pinned binary injected by the flake-parts module as an internal option (turnkey.buck2.package), like tellerLib, since it has no standalone path without that injection anyway. mappings.nix buck2 skip entries removed (resolves that fog patch). Verified: flake check + builds, fresh shell, docs shell has no buck2, both errors fire, tk build + test with a recorded hit.

title: Replace toolchain.toml buck2 declarations with the per-shell option
